key: Clear WKWebView website data and development logs before opening the URL?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt (sensitive): clean start before opening a URL.

key: Check the current page for elements matching this selector?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt (page scope); the CSS selector is appended after a blank line and is not translated.

key: Walnut will also save the approved screenshot to Photos.
comment: Sentence appended (after a space) to the screenshot approval prompt when saving to Photos is requested.

key: Capture one image of this device’s entire display with SafariVC visible? Approve in the iOS picker, then review the image before sharing.
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt for a SafariVC display screenshot.

key: Share a screenshot of the WKWebView test page with the connected Mac and its agent?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt for a WKWebView screenshot; may be followed by the Photos sentence.

key: Share this display screenshot with the connected Mac and its agent?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt shown with the captured display image preview; may be followed by the Photos sentence.

key: Walnut will also save the video to Photos.
comment: Sentence appended to the screen recording approval prompt when saving to Photos is requested.

key: Record the app screen and share the video with the connected Mac and its agent?
comment: Mac Agent approval prompt for screen recording.

key: If iOS asks separately, approve screen capture on the iPhone.
comment: Sentence appended to the screen recording approval prompt.

key: A screen recording is already active or awaiting approval.
comment: Failure text shown when starting a screen recording while another is active or pending.

key: Recording was stopped before it started.

comment: Recording failure text when ReplayKit capture is unavailable.
Recording failure text shown in the Recording Not Saved alert.
Recording failure text shown in the Recording Not Saved alert.

key: Could not save to Photos. The recording file was kept.
comment: Recording failure text; a system error description follows after a space.
Recording failure text; a system error description follows after a space.
